brainlife.desc: Experimental: left/right GIFTI data per surface vertex (measures, time series or label annotations), with optional label.json.
brainlife.name: neuro/surface/data

original.desc: (experimental) surface data data.nii only contains measures at each vertices. The 3d coordinates for each vertices (the actual 3D mesh) can be stored using neuro/surface/vertices datatype

brainlife.readme:
**Use for:** Surface-based analysis of fMRI time series, measures or parcellations.

**Not for:** Use without the matching surface mesh (neuro/surface/vertices) and space tag.

**BIDS:** anat/dseg (partial)

**Sharing:** Tier 2 (pseudonymised participant-level) by default.

**Apps:** Input to 12 Apps, output of 10 Apps.

Full record: https://github.com/brainlife/abcd-spec/blob/master/datatypes/neuro.surface.data.json
